criteria.rationale: Born December 4, 1997, the patient was 28 on the September 1, 2026 request date.
The request is for chronic weight management, and the prescribing note proposes Wegovy for overweight after a weight-loss plateau.
Within 180 days of the request, the patient was documented following an approximately 1,800-kcal diet and walking four days weekly. The August prescribing note says to continue the lifestyle plan.

The dietitian-led program began October 27, 2025, with a calorie-reduction plan, walking, and planned follow-up. January, April, and August notes document continued participation without a recorded interruption, exceeding six whole calendar months.
The latest structured BMI before the request was 28.1 kg/m², and active dyslipidemia is a documented qualifying weight-related comorbidity.
